title: Cybersecurity roadmap
description: Start with the common foundations, then pick a CISSP domain. Two kinds of sub-roadmaps follow: domain roadmaps (d1 to d8) and paths by role or approach that cross domains (offensive, defensive, purple team, incident response and forensics, GRC, application security, cloud, architecture, CISSP).

nodes.title: The CISSP map of the field
nodes.description: The eight domains used as the top level structure of this repository. See also the thematic roadmap cissp-study-map.

nodes.title: Domain 1: Security and risk management
nodes.description: Sub-roadmap d1-security-and-risk-management: governance, risk, threat modeling, awareness, privacy law.

nodes.title: Domain 2: Asset security
nodes.description: Sub-roadmap d2-asset-security: privacy and data protection, with classification and lifecycle planned.

nodes.title: Domain 3: Security architecture and engineering
nodes.description: Sub-roadmap d3-security-architecture-and-engineering: design, cryptography, operating systems, cloud, Kubernetes, AI.

nodes.title: Domain 4: Communication and network security
nodes.description: Sub-roadmap d4-communication-and-network-security: network foundations, protocols, segmentation, zero trust, filtering, secure transport, monitoring and operations.

nodes.title: Domain 5: Identity and access management
nodes.description: Sub-roadmap d5-identity-and-access-management: authentication, authorization, protocols, credential attacks.

nodes.title: Domain 6: Security assessment and testing
nodes.description: Sub-roadmap d6-security-assessment-and-testing: team exercises, with testing methods planned.

nodes.title: Domain 7: Security operations
nodes.description: Sub-roadmap d7-security-operations: threats, intelligence, vulnerabilities, detection, response, forensics.

nodes.title: Domain 8: Software development security
nodes.description: Sub-roadmap d8-software-development-security: OWASP, testing, supply chain.

nodes.title: Path: offensive security
nodes.description: Sub-roadmap offensive-security: Attacker view for authorized testing: attack lifecycle, web and credential attacks, ATT&CK, reporting.

nodes.title: Path: defensive security (blue team)
nodes.description: Sub-roadmap defensive-security: Detection, SOC, SIEM, response, hardening and intelligence.

nodes.title: Path: purple team
nodes.description: Sub-roadmap purple-team: Attack and detection side by side, mapped to ATT&CK and D3FEND.

nodes.title: Path: incident response and forensics
nodes.description: Sub-roadmap incident-response-and-forensics: Detect, respond, preserve evidence.

nodes.title: Path: governance, risk and compliance
nodes.description: Sub-roadmap grc-and-privacy: Frameworks, risk, controls, privacy law, certifications.

nodes.title: Path: application security and DevSecOps
nodes.description: Sub-roadmap appsec-and-devsecops: OWASP, testing, supply chain.

nodes.title: Path: cloud and Kubernetes security
nodes.description: Sub-roadmap cloud-and-kubernetes-posture: CSPM, KSPM, tools, frameworks.

nodes.title: Path: security architecture and engineering
nodes.description: Sub-roadmap security-architecture-path: Design principles, cryptography, zero trust, identity.

nodes.title: Path: CISSP study map
nodes.description: Sub-roadmap cissp-study-map: The credential and its eight domains.
